correctness.rationale: The proof gives explicit legal local sequences, an exact 7-pebble F2 base, an induction on the number of triangles preserving a hub pebble and sufficient mass, a second induction on total size, and a one-move hubless reduction. The residual hub size 3 is handled by spending one extra pebble on two separate leaf shuttles. Executed exact independent-state recursion exhaustively checked all F2/F3 threshold distributions, including all labelled unstackable predecessors.

value.rationale: A natural block-graph family receives a constructive all-r upper bound 4r instead of a generic 16r+8 diameter bound, plus a threshold on hub occupancy that explains the mechanism. Exact sharpness for the first two nontrivial friendship graphs verifies the bound is not a mere tautological relabelling. The result is an infinite-family structural lemma, not an arbitrary finite slice; larger-r equality remains open.
